front: Ward an area so you are alerted when creatures enter without the password, by a mental alert or an audible bell.
back:
Choose a password. When a Small or larger corporeal creature enters without speaking it, you get your choice of a mental alert (spell gains mental trait) or a hand-bell sound (auditory trait). Either wakes you automatically; the bell lets creatures in the area attempt a DC 15 Perception check to wake.
A creature aware of the alarm must succeed at Stealth vs. the spell DC to enter without triggering it.
Heightened (3rd): can specify a trigger for which creatures set it off.
